Retrieve data from a TÜİK SDMX Dataflow

Source: R/data.R
tuik_get_data.Rd

Retrieves all series with filters = NULL, or builds a complete SDMX key from supplied filters. Partial filters require explicit permission via allow_all = TRUE or filter_mode = "local": the service's all data are retrieved first and filters are applied in R. At least one period bound is required unless allow_unbounded = TRUE. This is NOT server-side filtering and can download large responses even for a short period. Complete filters are always queried by SDMX key on the server.

Usage

tuik_get_data(
  profile,
  filters = NULL,
  start_period = NULL,
  end_period = NULL,
  parse_observation = TRUE,
  validate = TRUE,
  api_key = NULL,
  allow_unbounded = FALSE,
  labels = c("none", "tr", "en", "both"),
  label_dimensions = NULL,
  filter_mode = c("reject", "local"),
  allow_all = FALSE
)

Arguments

profile

A tuik_flow_profile object or a single Dataflow ID. When an ID is supplied, a profile is resolved automatically with tuik_flow_profile() using the same api_key. For explicit Dataflow agency/version selection, construct a profile first.

filters

NULL to request all series, or a named list of key-dimension selections. Partial selections require allow_all = TRUE (or legacy filter_mode = "local") before the service's all data are downloaded.

start_period

Optional start period, for example "2026-01".

end_period

Optional end period, for example "2026-03".

parse_observation

Logical. If TRUE, attempts to convert OBS_VALUE to numeric while preserving all SDMX dimensions and attributes as character columns.

validate

Logical. If TRUE, validate supplied filter values against the Codelists referenced by the Dataflow DSD before requesting data. Defaults to TRUE.

api_key

Optional API key. If NULL, the TUIK_SDMX_API_KEY environment variable is used.

allow_unbounded

Logical. Must be TRUE to permit unfiltered or locally filtered requests with neither period bound supplied. This can download a very large dataset. Does not limit the server response size.

labels

Language of optional Codelist labels: "none" (the default), "tr", "en", or "both". Raw SDMX codes remain unchanged.

label_dimensions

Optional character vector of dimension IDs to decode when labels is not "none". If NULL, decode all coded dimensions present in the downloaded data.

filter_mode

Legacy explicit mode: "reject" (default) or "local". Existing calls remain supported. For new code, prefer allow_all = TRUE to authorize a locally filtered all request.

allow_all

Logical, default FALSE. With incomplete filters, TRUE authorizes an all request and applies the specified filters locally. This is the same opt-in used by tuik_available_codes(). It DOES NOT limit transferred bytes, memory, or response time. It does not bypass allow_unbounded when neither period bound is provided.

Value

A tibble containing SDMX observations. If labels are requested, additional <DIMENSION>_label_tr and/or <DIMENSION>_label_en columns are appended. Labels identify Codelist-defined values, not observed availability.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Requires TUIK_SDMX_API_KEY in the environment.
library(tuiksdmx)
profile <- tuik_flow_profile("DF_TUFE_SDMX_TT01")

data <- tuik_get_data(
  profile,
  filters = list(
    REF_AREA = "TR",
    FREQ = "M",
    SINIFLAMA_DUZEYI = "2",
    DEGISIM = "1",
    OZEL_KAPSAM_TUFE = "_Z",
    BASE_PER = "2025",
    YAYIM_DONEMI = "2026_01",
    COICOP_1999 = "_Z",
    COICOP_2018 = "01",
    INDICATOR = "F_TFE"
  ),
  start_period = "2026-01",
  end_period = "2026-03"
)
} # }
